name: Galactus
summary: A world-eater who is not evil, only hungry. Galactus, once the mortal Galan, roams the cosmos consuming planets and sending heralds like the Silver Surfer ahead of him.
origin: Galactus is less a villain than a natural disaster with a helmet. He showed up in Fantastic Four #48 in 1966, when Stan Lee and Jack Kirby wanted a foe that felt closer to a god than a bad guy. The backstory came later: he was once Galan, a man from the universe that existed before ours, who survived its end and was reborn as a vast being who must feed on the life energy of whole planets. He wields the Power Cosmic, sends heralds such as the Silver Surfer to scout his meals, and in Marvel cosmology he helps keep the universe in balance. The scariest thing about him is that he isn't cruel, just hungry.
powers: Feeds on the life energy of planets
Can grant cosmic power to his heralds

storyline.title: The coming of Galactus
storyline.beat: Galactus arrives in Fantastic Four #48–50 with his herald, the Silver Surfer, to consume Earth. The Surfer turns against him, Reed Richards gets hold of the Ultimate Nullifier, and Galactus agrees to leave.

storyline.title: Survivor of a dead universe
storyline.beat: Thor reveals that Galactus was once Galan, a man from the universe before ours who survived its end and was reborn as a planet-devouring cosmic being.

storyline.title: Should he have been saved?
storyline.beat: Reed is put on trial by alien empires for once saving the dying Galactus, a story that frames Galactus as a necessary force of nature.

storyline.title: Unleashed
storyline.beat: In the Annihilation event Galactus is freed from captivity and turned loose on an invading cosmic army, showing just how vast his power is.

storyline.title: From eater to creator
storyline.beat: In The Ultimates his hunger is cured and he becomes the Lifebringer, restoring dead worlds, though the change does not last.

gossip.text: Jack Kirby added the Silver Surfer to the Galactus story on his own, and Stan Lee only found out when the pages arrived.
Galactus destroys worlds because he is evil.
gossip.truth: He is usually shown as a cosmic force beyond good and evil who must eat planets to survive.

gossip.text: He once was Galan, a man from the universe that existed before the Big Bang.
Ralph Ineson played Galactus in the 2025 film The Fantastic Four: First Steps.
Silver Surfer, his most famous herald, made his debut in the same story as Galactus.

quiz.why: He was Galan of the planet Taa.

quiz.q: Which herald came with him in his first story?
quiz.why: The Silver Surfer debuted alongside him in 1966.

quiz.q: Which weapon drove Galactus away from Earth in 1966?
quiz.why: Reed Richards threatened him with the Ultimate Nullifier.

theme.tagline: World-eater. Picky about none of them.

timeline.title: The Galactus Trilogy
timeline.note: Fantastic Four #48 brings the planet-eater and his herald, the Silver Surfer, to Earth in one of comics' most famous arcs.

timeline.title: Cartoon world-eater
timeline.note: The Hanna-Barbera Fantastic Four series adapts the Galactus saga for Saturday-morning TV.

timeline.title: Survivor of the last universe
timeline.note: Thor #168 and #169 reveal Galactus began as Galan, the lone survivor of the universe before ours.

timeline.title: The Trial of Galactus
timeline.note: Fantastic Four #262 puts Reed on trial for saving Galactus, asking whether a world-eater deserves to live.

timeline.title: Weapon in Annihilation
timeline.note: The Annihilation event sees Galactus captured and turned into a cosmic weapon against whole star systems.

timeline.title: A storm cloud on screen
timeline.note: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer shows Galactus as a giant cosmic cloud, a choice fans still debate.

timeline.title: From eater to lifebringer
timeline.note: The Ultimates transform Galactus into a bringer of life, flipping his hunger into creation.

timeline.title: The towering MCU giant
timeline.note: The Fantastic Four: First Steps finally shows Galactus in full, with Ralph Ineson under the giant helmet.
